title: Let the payout rules run without the bank

blocks.text: The claims service pays approved insurance claims through the bank's API and keeps an audit line for every decision. Nobody has tested the payout rules since the bank integration went in: the CI machines have no `BANK_URL`, and the last person who ran the tests on a machine that had one paid a test claim for real.

The team has settled the shape in `src/main/java/practice/Payouts.java`: `PayoutPolicy` receives a `Transfers` and an `AuditTrail` in its constructor, and the code that starts the service passes it a `BankTransfers` and the real audit trail. `Registry` is how older parts of the service find shared objects; it is being retired.
Finish the constructor, `payOne` and `skip`, so that the tests can run the payout rules with a fake bank and a list for an audit trail:

items: an approved claim with a positive amount is paid and recorded as `paid <claim id> <reference>`;
any other claim is recorded as `skipped <claim id>`;
a policy wired up with something missing is refused while the service is starting, not when the first claim comes in.

cases.says: approved claims are paid through the transfers the policy was given, in order, and each payment is recorded with its reference
a declined or zero claim is not paid and is recorded in the audit trail the policy was given, not one looked up elsewhere
building the policy with no transfers fails right there with NullPointerException, instead of falling back to the production bank
building the policy with no audit trail fails right there with NullPointerException, not at the first payout

origin.section: A Constructor Parameter Turns a Forgotten Dependency Into a Compile Error

concepts: A dependency taken through the constructor is a compile error when the wiring forgets it, and requireNonNull refuses a null at construction; a service locator lookup fails only at the first request that needs it.
A policy that constructs its own detail can't be built, and so can't be tested, without that detail; taking an interface through the constructor lets a test pass a fake.
